scope: Expanded UK directory; source-reviewed places and online resources. Growing coverage, not an exhaustive census.

entries.note: Delivery zones, chilled items and minimum orders have separate conditions.

entries.summary: Exhibitions, film, music and cultural programmes, a short walk from Trafalgar Square.
entries.note: Check the current programme and booking requirements for each event.

entries.summary: Structured Korean courses for your first words, everyday conversations and everything that follows.
entries.note: A subscription service. Check current plans, billing currency and trial terms.

entries.summary: Find a local taekwondo club through the national governing body’s own directory.
entries.note: This is a club-finding website, not an online training class. Confirm ages, venue, fees and trial sessions with the individual club.

entries.name: Maangchi
entries.summary: Cook your first Korean meal with step-by-step recipes, videos and an ingredient guide.
entries.note: A global English-language resource available from the UK. Recipes use the author’s own measurements and terminology.

entries.name: Korea Foods & Seoul Plaza
entries.summary: Find Korean groceries around the UK using the retailer’s own store guide.
entries.note: A store-finding resource covering multiple branches. Use the retailer’s map to confirm your chosen branch; no headquarters pin is shown.

entries.note: Check the restaurant’s current menu and opening times.

entries.summary: Korean food in Edinburgh, with dine-in, collection and local delivery options.
entries.note: Local food delivery is not treated as a UK-wide online resource. Check opening times and book with the restaurant.

entries.name: Korea gallery · British Museum
entries.summary: Explore Korean ceramics, art and a reconstructed scholar’s study in Room 67, or take the virtual tour.
entries.note: General admission is free. Advance booking is advised; check gallery access before travelling.

entries.name: Korea at the V&A
entries.summary: Explore Korean craft, fashion and design through collection stories, films and object records.
entries.note: This listing is for the online collection. Individual objects may not be on display, so check each record before planning a museum visit.

entries.name: London Korean Film Festival
entries.summary: Discover the festival’s film programme, cinema screenings and archive of previous editions.
entries.note: A programme and booking website for in-person screenings at several venues. It is not a streaming service; confirm dates and venues on each film page.

entries.name: Korean Education Centre UK
entries.summary: Official information on Korean learning, TOPIK exams, school programmes and studying in Korea.
entries.note: An information service. Check the latest course notices for eligibility, delivery format and application dates.

entries.name: UK Taekwon-Do Council · Clubs
entries.summary: Find taekwon-do classes using the provider’s regional directory across the UK.

entries.name: Korean Bapsang
